lines.text: As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Jesus.
Two blind men sat beside the road and cried out, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"
The crowd told the two blind men to be silent, but they cried out all the louder.
Jesus stopped and called them, and they asked Him to let their ears be opened.
Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes, and at once they received their sight and followed Him.
